featured_reviews.review_text:
Had my badminton racquet restringed and racquet head shape was altered after gutting, which only came to my attention after reaching home. I went back to the store within 10 mins of picking up the racquet and they simply said you should have checked before you left. Total loss for me as i lost a racquet and gutting charges.

PS- After reading the reply from owner, I have to add some more, I have been to this store multiple times and never had such an experience with any product or staff. The owner is right that I checked the racquet and that issues was not noticed by me then but it is also true that I got back to the store in 10 to 15 mins after I collected the racquet. My mistake was that I only checked it thoroughly after I reached home. So if you are alleging that I am raising a false claim, please understand that as a customer I have all the right to raise the concern after spending my money at your store for a service or product which is not upto my expectations. Do try to develop some professional ethics while dealing with customers who raise issues by giving a solution rather alleging them and then giving store credits for next stringing because after a service and experience like this, I will not be visiting your store again for using your store credits.

description: Sports store with 6,000 products & 60+ sports. Wide range of walking & running shoes for men & women. Gear up with raincoats, rain jackets, rainwear and umbrellas. owner_posts.post_text: The Spirit Goggles Tinted Blue are designed for swimmers who train regularly and need lasting performance. Built with high chlorine durability, they maintain their quality and clarity even after frequent pool sessions. The tinted lenses help reduce glare in bright conditions, offering clearer vision and enhanced focus. A secure, comfortable fit ensures stability during laps, dives, and turns. Designed to stay reliable swim after swim, these goggles combine durability, comfort, and performance in one streamlined design. Whether you're training indoors or outdoors, they help you stay focused, protected, and ready to push your limits in the water.

The Jogflow 190 Grip Running Shoes are built to keep you steady, cushioned, and comfortable on every run. A 3.5 mm lugged outsole enhances grip, giving you better traction across varied surfaces. IMEVA foam cushioning absorbs impact efficiently, helping reduce strain with every stride. Inside, the padded, seamless construction minimises friction and maximises comfort, so you can focus on your pace without distractions. Whether you're heading out for daily training or longer endurance runs, these shoes combine reliable grip, responsive cushioning, and all-day comfort to support smoother, more confident movement from start to finish.

"Stand out in deep blue this tournament season. Grab our latest football gear and matchday jerseys, built for maximum comfort and great pitch performance. Whether you are hosting a watch party or training with your team, Decathlon offers quality sports equipment at prices you'll love. Upgrade your wardrobe with our durable, high-quality football collection today. That explosive, tactical football feeling, get it at Decathlon. Shop the range now before stocks run out!"

The MT 100 EASYFIT 50L backpack is built for dependable performance on every trek. Backed by a 10-year warranty, it’s designed to last through countless adventures. Smart multi-pocket organisation keeps essentials easy to access, while the expandable bottom compartment offers extra space when you need it most. A padded back panel and supportive shoulder straps enhance carrying comfort, even on long hikes. Whether you're heading for a weekend getaway or a multi-day trail, this 50L backpack balances durability, storage flexibility, and ergonomic support to help you travel prepared and comfortably.

Back to School, Back to Sport! Unleash your child’s full potential with our ultimate Kids Sporty School Essentials. From the morning bell to the final whistle, our collection provides the perfect blend of durability and athletic style. Whether they are sprinting to class or leading the team during gym period, our gear is engineered to keep them moving with total confidence. Explore our comprehensive range of performance-ready outfits and accessories today. Visit us to gear up and kickstart their most active, high-energy school year yet!

Built for confident exploration, the Mountain Bike Rockrider EXPL40 is designed to keep every ride comfortable and controlled. Its upright riding position reduces strain and enhances visibility, making long rides more enjoyable. The one-click gear shifting system ensures smooth, effortless transitions across terrains, so you can focus on the trail ahead. Whether you’re navigating city paths or venturing onto rugged tracks, the EXPL40 is engineered to make every ride stable, smooth, and adventure-ready.

Designed for high-impact workouts, this zipped sports bra delivers reliable support without compromising on comfort. Its advanced support system keeps you secure through intense training, while elastane-enhanced stretch allows free, natural movement. The breathable, quick-dry fabric helps manage sweat efficiently, keeping you cool and confident from warm-up to cooldown. Easy to wear and remove, the front zip adds everyday convenience to a performance-driven design. Whether you’re running, training, or powering through high-energy sessions, this sports bra is built to move with you and support every stride, rep, and jump.

Disconnect from the screens and step into the real world with our limited-edition travel collection. Crafted for those ready to trade the desk for the destination, this exclusive gear is built for your next great escape.

It’s time to ditch the endless notifications, pack your essentials, and reconnect with the journey. Whether you are hitting the trails, catching the breeze, or exploring somewhere new, your adventure starts here.

Drop by our store or shop the collection online and upgrade your travel gear before it sells out.

"Enjoy your daily strolls in complete comfort with these cushioned walking shoes. Designed with a shock-absorbing sole, they soak up the impact from hard pavements to protect your feet and joints with every step.

The flexible insoles and outsoles bend naturally with your foot's movement, providing a highly comfortable, unrestricted walk. Underneath, a reliable rubber sole delivers great grip on all urban surfaces, keeping you steady on city streets, sidewalks, and parks. They are the perfect choice for anyone looking for a simple, soft, and dependable everyday walking shoe."

"Elevate your game with these reliable adult's basketball shoes, built to handle both indoor and outdoor courts. Designed with mid-ankle support, they keep your feet stable and secure during quick cuts, jumps, and multi-directional movements.

The durable upper and tough rubber outsole are highly resistant to wear and tear, making them perfect for frequent play. Plus, the sole features large traction patterns for excellent grip on the court, and it uses non-marking rubber so it won't leave scuffs on indoor floors. It is the perfect choice for players looking for simple, durable support."

featured_reviews.review_text:
I never expected such pathetic service from Decathlon. I ordered a T-shirt, but the size didn’t fit properly, so I requested an exchange for size S. Instead of helping, the company suddenly cancelled the exchange without any proper reason. The delivery was showing for 24th April, and then it got cancelled from their side.

I contacted customer care multiple times — no proper response. I even sent emails, but still no reply. Their AI chat keeps repeating the same useless message saying “keep the product ready in the same packaging,” when I had already returned the T-shirt on 19th April. I even have OTP proof from the delivery boy as evidence.

Taking customers’ money is easy for them, but when it comes to support, refund, or exchange, they completely disappear. This is one of the worst and most careless services I’ve ever experienced. Stop wasting customers’ time and money. Absolutely disgusting service. 🤬

featured_reviews.review_text:
Our team had a wonderful shopping experience at Platinum Sports in Tilak Nagar while preparing for our upcoming cricket match. As soon as we entered the shop, we were greeted by friendly and helpful staff who guided us patiently through the wide range of sports equipment. The store had everything we needed—from high-quality bats, balls, gloves, pads, helmets, and jerseys to shoes and accessories.

The staff helped us choose the right equipment according to our age and playing level, and they even gave us useful tips on maintaining our gear. The prices were reasonable, and the quality of products was excellent. The billing process was quick and smooth, which saved us a lot of time.

featured_reviews.name: Anil k
featured_reviews.review_text:
Platinum Sports offers an overall average experience—neither exceptional nor disappointing. The brand delivers decent quality across its range of products, from fitness apparel to sports accessories, but it doesn’t particularly stand out in any category. The materials used are durable and comfortable for everyday use, though they may not match the premium feel or advanced technology found in top-tier sports brands. Pricing is reasonable and provides fair value for money, making it a suitable choice for casual users and beginners rather than professional athletes.

Customer service is adequate, with satisfactory response times, but post-sale support could be improved. The brand’s online presence and packaging are professional, though product availability sometimes varies across regions. In terms of performance, items like shoes and training gear serve well for regular workouts or light sports activity but might lack the advanced support required for intense performance.

Overall, Platinum Sports can be described as a “safe middle ground”—a brand that meets basic expectations without major flaws but also without the innovation or premium edge that might attract demanding athletes. It’s reliable for daily fitness needs, but there’s room for improvement in design, technology, and customer engagement to reach a higher standard.

featured_reviews.name: pratham kamath
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a pathetic experience buying shoes from here, don’t misunderstand me, staff members are very nice and helpful even the store manager is very helpful but I’ll explain my issue in detail bellow 👇

On October 10th I bought a pair of shoes for 10k, as an ongoing offer I was offered the customisation for free, for that I explained my design on the store and the person said “yes I will do and you’ll get it by tomorrow” (I don’t wanna name anyone here). The next day I get a call saying “please visit the store we aren’t sure of doing it without your presence”

Now I reached the store, the design was ready, everything was good to go but the design on the computer screen and the shoes looked miles apart, not even worth looking at, I’ll attach the photos bellow.

I was then told to take the shoes home and that they’ll get back to me, for next two days no one picked my call or when they did they’d stall me saying the person who customises is not available. Then I had to fly to Banaras (the reason I bought these shoes) without a pair of shoes. I came back and called the store, same with happened then I finally got in touch with the store manager and also placed a complaint at the Puma helpline.

Finally they arranged a replacement for the same but what comes next is shocking, I was called to the store yet again, only to find out the staff telling me “apne complaint nahi karna chahiye tha na sir, isko job is in risk” obviously as a human I felt bad and withdrew the complaint.

The second time it turned out to be good and I walked out with my shoes.
Got a call from the higher authority, explained him everything and he said he’ll take action and get back to me, I’m yet to hear from him.

Overall it turned out to be okay but this whole process took 11 days and I got my shoes finally on 22nd October.

My advice would be to not go for customisation as if it’s not done properly it’ll take super long for you to get it replaced. If it’s a simple word or design, you’re good to go.

*And before anyone asks me, neither was I  compensated for my extra travel cost that I incurred nor for my time* all I received was an apology and a thanks for understanding.

Overall as I said a pathetic experience.

"NEVER EVER BUY FROM THESE SCAMMERS" Worst experience ever. I ordered 20mm rubber floor tiles and received them in a pre-used, unusable condition. featured_reviews.name: adwait patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing and frustrating experience with SF Health Tech. I paid ₹40,000 as an advance for a bench and barbell, but the company failed to deliver the equipment within the promised timeline. Instead, I kept receiving repeated excuses and shifting commitments—first I was told delivery would happen on Saturday, then it was pushed to Thursday, and still nothing was delivered.
When I requested a refund, the situation became worse. They are now delaying the refund as well and are not providing any proof or confirmation of the refund process. Communication has been poor and inconsistent throughout.
This kind of behavior shows a complete lack of professionalism and accountability, especially when dealing with customers’ hard-earned money. I would strongly advise others to be cautious before making any payment to this company.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwin Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unlike other customer reviews, my experience with SF Health tech has been awfully bad.

Standard Bench:
- My unboxing  experience was seriously jeopardised as the item received was rusted and there was fungal growth all over it.
- The bench was dented and had scratches at multiple areas.
- And finally the bench, I suppose it has some design concerns as it was not sitting firmly on the ground.

Basic Weightlifting package
- Weight plates had colour bleeding issue. They seemed used, as I noticed multiple scratches and depressions in it.
- The only good thing out of my whole order turned out to be Cerakote barbell. It feels solid and of good quality.

After Sales Experience:
If you think my delivery experience was awful, then wait for the after sales service. It is been 3 week since the order was delivered, unfortunately the team has not completed the reverse pickup until today. And to make things worse, team expects you to repackage the whole set of returning items and keep it ready for the pickup team, Please note, repacking the Bench is not anyones cup of tea, first of all its heavy and large. I don't understand why team can't apprehend this part and is hell bent in making things worse for already annoyed customers.
